t: You're looking at the Gilbert Collection, a collection of objets d'art that now has its permanent home in the Victoria and Albert Museum. It was assembled by Sir Arthur Gilbert, who made most of his fortune in property in California. He began with an interest in silver, then built up a large collection of decorative arts. In 1996 he gave it to the British nation, and the collection carries his name, together with that of Rosalinde Gilbert.
